en.content:
Using motion storyboards (storyboards) created in Blender as input for video generation in Seedance 2.0, utilizing them as the basis for movement.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
Since Tetetsurou was using motion storyboards created in Blender for video generation in Seedance 2.0, I wanted to try it and have been working on it since yesterday.

Being a complete beginner with no knowledge of 3D imagery, I struggled a lot.
For now, please be considerate as this is my first attempt at a motion storyboard using Blender m(__)m
